attchmntText: Intimation regarding bankruptcy of Mr. Venugopal Dhoot.
voiceSummary: Videocon Industries Limited intimates that the National Company Law Tribunal declared promoter Venugopal Dhoot as insolvent on November 5, 2026. The order follows a petition by State Bank of India due to Dhoot's failure to repay credit facilities backed by his personal guarantee. The personal insolvency resolution process was terminated after creditors rejected a repayment plan. The company is currently under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process.

attchmntText: Pre-facto intimation of the upcoming 67th (Sixty- Seventh) meeting of the Committee of Creditors (CoC).
voiceSummary: Videocon Industries Limited has issued a pre-facto intimation regarding the scheduling of the 67th meeting of the consolidated Committee of Creditors. The meeting is scheduled to be held on Friday, November 27, 2026. This follows a previous intimation dated November 20, 2026, regarding the postponement of the meeting. The consolidated Committee of Creditors covers Videocon Industries Limited and twelve other Videocon group companies under a consolidated corporate insolvency resolution process. The meeting is convened in accordance with Regulation 19 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India regulations. The resolution professional, Abhijit Guhathakurta, has requested that the exchanges take this information on record.

attchmntText: Intimation regarding postponement of the 67th (Sixty Seventh) meeting of the Committee of Creditors (CoC).
voiceSummary: Videocon Industries Limited has postponed its 67th Committee of Creditors meeting, originally scheduled for November 20, 2026. The postponement was requested by the Committee of Creditors. The meeting concerns the consolidated corporate insolvency resolution process for Videocon Industries Limited and twelve other Videocon group companies. The revised date and time for the meeting will be communicated at a later stage. The company is currently under the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process by National Company Law Tribunal order dated June 6, 2018. Abhijit Guhathakurta is the Resolution Professional for the thirteen Videocon group companies.
